d: India's Supreme Court has instructed the country's apex food authority, The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India or FSSAI to crack down on food manufacturers that sell packaged food including chips, soft drinks and ready to heat and eat food. The Supreme court has tasked the FSSAI with coming up with clear health guidelines at the front of food packaging that would state whether the food has high sugar, salt or fats.
